subject: Finalize prompt/output purge for Petra — execution + customer signoff
messages:
From: Alex Davies <alex.davies@petralabs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Petra Security <security@petralabs.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge prompts & outputs tied to Project Zeta

Hi Vanessa,

We need to schedule a formal purge of all prompt inputs, generated outputs, and related request logs for Project Zeta (customer-facing PII scrubbed flows) across both the hosted and our dedicated footprint. This is tied to our internal compliance closure for an acquisition.

Scope:
- All prompt and output artifacts created between 2026-05-01 and 2028-07-01
- Associated request/trace logs and KV cache snapshots that can reconstruct outputs
- Backups in the eu-west-1 snapshot bucket created by the retention job on 2027-12-01

We need: an ops runbook we can sign, confirmation emails (to be archived for our records), and a compact evidence manifest showing files removed. Ideally a DocuSign or signed acknowledgement we can attach to our audit.

Can you confirm timing and next steps? We are targeting completion by EOD Mon 2028-07-24 (our legal cut-off).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Davies
Head of DataOps, Petra Labs
---
Opinion: priority high for legal.
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Davies <alex.davies@petralabs.com>
Cc: Petra Security <security@petralabs.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Jul 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge prompts & outputs tied to Project Zeta

Alex — thanks for the clear scope. We can execute this within your timeline. High-level plan:

1) Pre-check: run membership scan to enumerate all artifacts matching project tags and time window (inventory).
2) Canary purge: remove a small set and produce a signed manifest to validate process and evidence formatting.
3) Full purge: run sweep across hosted + dedicated (KV/kv-cache trimming + object deletion + request-log expunge).
4) Evidence package: signed manifest (file list + deletion timestamps + S3 object versions), Ops ticket snapshot, and DS acknowledgement.

I will kick this off with our Ops team and send the runbook for your review.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Customer Ops — Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0182
